# `liber:hotplug-device@1`

Generated reference for the `liber:hotplug-device` package (`hotplug-device.lsidl`). See [the LSIDL language](../../../LSIDL.md).

LiberSystem plugged memory - the contract a `memory-hotplug` provider serves: memory a virtual machine's host plugs in at run time, and the allowance ResourceManager grants for it.  A PROTOCOL OF ITS OWN, NOT THE BALLOON'S. A balloon gives the host memory the machine has; plugged memory is memory the host adds and may ask back - and what it asks back is given only once nothing here holds it: a block with one frame in use stays plugged, whatever the host asks, until that frame is freed. ResourceManager, the one consumer, allows how much may be plugged and is told how much the host asked back that is still in use.  IN BYTES, whole blocks of the device's block size.
